creativeDirection.mood: Cosy, motivating, warm despite the cold
creativeDirection.visualRules: Warm indoor lighting, cold outdoor contrast shots, winter apparel cues
creativeDirection.bannedVisuals: Summer golf imagery, beach/pool adjacent content
creativeDirection.copyDirection: Tone: 'perfect day to practice indoors.' Contrast cold outside vs warm inside
creativeDirection.realFootage: Real indoor simulator footage, warm lighting shots

identity.name: Major Swing Service

creativeDirection.visualRules: Tournament graphics overlay, leaderboard aesthetics, countdown to major events

creativeDirection.realFootage: Tournament B-roll where available. TrackMan data overlays with tournament context
